visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A bald man in a yellow shirt and a woman in a grey cardigan stand on a balcony. The woman touches her hair with a frustrated expression while the man laughs behind her. The background is a plain wall under overcast natural light. (2) Indoors, the woman holds up a pink tube and a small glass bottle of facial oil (BEIGIC). She is smiling and gesturing towards the products. The background is a domestic interior with wooden window frames. (3) The woman applies the oil to her face with her fingers. In the background, seen through a mirror or window, the man pops his head in and makes funny faces. She looks at the camera while applying the product. (4) The woman displays a larger white tube of scrub and a tube of tone-up cream. She demonstrates the application of the cream to her cheek, rubbing it in with her hands. Yellow text overlays appear occasionally. (5) In a bright bathroom, the man has a towel around his neck. He squeezes a white cream from a BEIGIC tube onto his hand and rubs it vigorously onto his bald head over a sink. (6) Back in the living room area, the woman shows two small jars of lip and cheek balm. She applies the pink balm to her lips and cheeks using her fingers. The man is visible in the background, leaning against a door frame. (7) The woman leans in and kisses the man's bald head. They both smile at the camera, posing close together in a domestic setting with soft natural light coming from a window.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced female speech complaining about her appearance, accompanied by low-volume indoor ambiance. (2) Upbeat, medium-tempo acoustic pop BGM fades in. The female voice begins a cheerful product explanation. (3) A wet 'splash' sound effect coincides with the man's playful interjection. Laughter is heard in the background. (4) Frequent 'click' and 'pop' transition SFX occur as the woman describes different skincare steps at a high speech rate. (5) Sound of running water and rhythmic hand scrubbing noises dominate as the male voice takes over, narrating his experience with a humorous, bright tone. (6) BGM continues steadily as the female voice returns to summarize the results. A final comedic sound effect plays during the closing interaction.
